assumptions.assumption: The model assumes that an XmlFile contains only one root element, which is represented by the association with Element.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R2: 'An attribute node' is not represented in the model.
Requirement R3: 'an XML file comprises Text elements' is not represented in the model.
Requirement R5: 'an XML file comprises Root elements' is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a use case or relationship involving Root elements.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R6: 'A Node of an XML file may have one parent which is an Element of the XML file' is not represented in the model.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Add a relationship between Node and Element indicating a parent-child association.

verifier_problems_last.issue: Requirement R7: 'An Element of an XML file can have many children Nodes' is partially represented, but the relationship type and direction are incorrect.
verifier_problems_last.fix: Correct the relationship between Element and Node to indicate many-to-many or one-to-many association.
